title: Handoff
description: Signed worker-to-orchestrator handoff for one feature (child WorkItem) of a Program. The worker's claims are ADVISORY: the orchestrator independently re-runs commands_run and compares. Mismatch is a hard fail (incident #1 pattern). See docs/design.md §Programs.

schema_version.description: Major version of this schema. Bumps are breaking.

program_id.description: Parent program ID. Worker MUST NOT invent this; the spawner injects it.

feature_id.description: Child WorkItem ID this handoff describes.

worker_run_id.description: Stable identifier for this worker invocation. A second attempt on the same feature gets a new worker_run_id.

worker_model_id.description: Provider-qualified model id (e.g. 'anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6'). Provider-agnostic — no Claude assumption.

base_sha.description: Worktree base commit at worker spawn.

head_sha.description: Worktree HEAD at handoff. MUST be reachable from base_sha + commit_shas.

commit_shas.description: Every commit the worker authored in this feature run. Orchestrator verifies reachability from head_sha and unreachability from base_sha.

success_state.description: Worker's self-assessment. ADVISORY; orchestrator-independent re-runs are the ground truth.

criteria_addressed.description: Acceptance-criterion IDs from the parent WorkItem the worker claims to have addressed. MUST be a subset of feature.acceptance_criteria[*].id (coverage check pre-merge).

commands_run.description: Commands the worker executed (build/test/lint). Each tuple is RE-RUN by the orchestrator in a sibling sandbox; the orchestrator's re-run result is HMAC-signed into program_verdicts. A mismatch on exit_code OR stdout_sha is a hard fail.

stdout_sha.description: sha256 of UTF-8-decoded stdout. Computed by the worker; verified by orchestrator re-run.

log_path.description: Worktree-relative path to the full log (for forensics). Not signed.

tests_added.description: Tests the worker added in this feature run.

addresses.description: Optional: acceptance-criterion IDs this test specifically pins.

falsifications.description: Adversarial self-review the worker performed before handoff. Each entry MUST carry a citation (^(test|file|commit)=\S+$ discipline); plain counts are not accepted. See docs/design.md §Programs §Handoff schema.

hypothesis.description: Concrete way the implementation could be wrong.

mutation_kind.description: Class of mutation tested. 'other' requires a non-empty 'target_invariant' that names the specific class.

target_invariant.description: What property the mutation tried to break.

citation.description: Evidence the falsification was actually executed. Same regex as WorkItem.acceptance_criteria.citation.

canary_archetype_killed.description: If this falsification corresponds to a canary archetype, the archetype ID. Empty if the falsification is bespoke to this feature.

outcome.description: Whether the falsification disproved (good, found bug), confirmed (good, ruled out), or was inconclusive (no signal — does NOT count toward falsification quality).

trap_patterns_claimed.description: Trap Catalog patterns the worker claims to have considered (P1–P13). For each pattern claimed, at least one falsifications[] entry MUST exist with outcome != 'inconclusive'.

discovered_issues.description: Issues the worker found but did not fix (out-of-scope, blocked, deferred).

unfinished_work.description: Acceptance-criterion IDs the worker did NOT address in this run, with reason inline.

return_to_orchestrator.description: If true, program halts pending orchestrator decision before next feature spawns.

prev_record_hash.description: SHA-256 of the previous audit record this writer emitted, canonicalized via JCS (RFC 8785). Chains every record per writer so dropped records become detectable downstream. Empty for the writer's first record. Documented in docs/auditor/audit-log.md.

signature.description: HMAC over canonicalized JCS payload (RFC 8785). Same key as gate_result.signature. Reused, NOT a new key.
